meaning: The asteroids inside Neptune's orbit that draw no marker of their own, one dot each: the brighter main-belt asteroids, Hildas and Jupiter Trojans of JPL's Small-Body Database where their orbits put them at the world's epoch, and the asteroids that have a page but are not mission targets at their own prepared positions. No color is taken from the database: the dot is the neutral gray the app gives every body without a measured color.
